entities.summary: Ronald L. Clark, Jr. is an American educator, author, and motivational speaker. He has taught in North Carolina and New York City, and later founded the Ron Clark Academy in Atlanta, Georgia. Clark is a New York Times bestselling author, known for his innovative approaches to education and teacher training.
